description: **C1, BUILD NOW.** A project can prove a user flow before a feature is called done: an opt-in, project-declared flow command (start, drive, inspect, clean up) with frozen expected outcomes, run by Compose and bound to the completion as evidence, so "tests pass" is no longer the only proof. Extends lib/completion-gate.js, lib/evidence.js and the compose skill. Out: a universal browser agent, a new daemon, any default-on gate.
